title: The Coming Assyrian Invasion

questions.question: Take a large tablet and write on it in common characters, "Belonging to whom?"
Before the boy knows how to cry "My father" or "My mother", the wealth of Damascus... will be carried away before the king of whom?
The Lord of hosts, him you shall honor as holy. Let him be your fear, and let him be your what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 8:13 (ESV): "Let him be your fear, and let him be your dread."

questions.question: And he will become a sanctuary and a stone of offense and a rock of stumbling to both houses of whom?
Bind up the testimony; seal the teaching among my what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 8:16 (ESV): "seal the teaching among my disciples."

questions.question: Because this people has refused the waters of Shiloah that flow gently, and rejoice over whom?
options: Rezin and the son of Remaliah
questions.correctAnswer: Rezin and the son of Remaliah
questions.explanation: Isaiah 8:6 (ESV): "and rejoice over Rezin and the son of Remaliah,"

questions.question: Therefore, behold, the Lord is bringing up against them the waters of the River, mighty and many, the king of whom?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 8:7 (ESV): "the king of Assyria and all his glory."

questions.question: And it will pass into Judah, it will overflow and pass on, reaching even to the what?
Take counsel together, but it will come to nothing; speak a word, but it will not stand, for who is with us?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 8:10 (ESV): "for God is with us." (Note: Immanuel means "God with us", but text says "for God is with us" or transliterated Immanuel. ESV translation uses "God is with us" in English here).

questions.question: And when they say to you, "Inquire of the mediums and the necromancers who chirp and mutter," should not a people inquire of their what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 8:19 (ESV): "should not a people inquire of their God?"

questions.question: To the teaching and to the testimony! If they will not speak according to this word, it is because they have no what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 8:20 (ESV): "it is because they have no dawn."

questions.question: They will pass through the land, greatly distressed and what?
And they will look to the earth, but behold, distress and darkness, the gloom of what?
And they will be thrust into thick what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 8:22 (ESV): "And they will be thrust into thick darkness."

questions.question: And I will get whom as reliable witnesses for myself: Uriah the priest and Zechariah the son of Jeberechiah?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 8:2 (ESV): "And I will get reliable witnesses for myself:"

key_verse_text: To the teaching and to the testimony! If they will not speak according to this word, it is because they have no dawn.
